scope: Entire new v6 conclusions/YAML/generated challenge, actual FeedbackNetwork and exact-type proofs, public import, new prepare/reproduce and source-capture inventories. No edits to these files or accepted723 history.

The typed J_upper→prime_power_feedback proof genuinely applies hj at L/2 only after proving L/2≥35. It combines the actual half-pi(sqrtx) remainder identity, actual pi<=J, the floor-height tail, and nonnegative retained allowance. No four-source input or guessed Q premise is added to this helper.

The ordinary transfer consumes its typed actual compensated-J profile and actual Q bound, then the actual PVli/Li2 offset. It does not relabel a desired result as an independent premise; the final composite constructs all intermediate providers from the four source inputs.

The actual Box psi provider, both-endpoint interval bound, complete minimum identity, preservation of v5 and strict1.67 whole-function gain align with the frozen four scientific files. The clean21/50 result uses the actual box_Li provider at log x and the whole-real scalar budget.

The final fully_derived_feedback_box_network has exactly RH, IntegratedPerron, Nicolas and BPT-off-ordinate source binders and visibly constructs J/Q/psi/pi/interval/.42 internally. All source predicates remain explicit B-tier, not RH-only or PV.

The 11 generated Challenge signatures match the 11 ExactFeedbackTypes examples and actual proof parameters. Challenge sorries are deliberate specifications excluded from the proof-source closure; actual solution proofs are separate.

The below70 identity at arbitrary real L is a pure equality of totalized functions. Its analytic uses establish the physical domain; this is an aligned harmless convention, not a material source mismatch.

capture_review.scope_basis: Explicit source/root inventories, not a name heuristic. Selector rejects missing/cyclic application imports, duplicate namespaces, new unlisted include payloads and Challenge imports. It preserves both original science freezes and binds current/captured source hashes.
capture_review.actual_compile_scope: Owner-reported provider/type CLI receipts need final fresh gate; this read-only review does not promote them.

new_reader_findings.actual_fragment: reproduce.py: rows and bodies use plain json.loads on RH_FEEDBACK_FINAL_THEOREM/BODY strings, while file JSON uses the inherited strict read helper.
new_reader_findings.concrete_trigger: A rehashed audit payload with duplicate axioms keys retains only the last value under json.loads. A hidden first nonstandard-axiom field can be overwritten by an empty second field. This is a static acceptance-path finding, not a claim that actual generated compiler logs contain duplicates.
new_reader_findings.impact: The reader can misdescribe modified evidence even though the unchanged Lean proofs remain kernel checked.
new_reader_findings.repair: Use strict duplicate-key/nonfinite parsing for both string payload routes, and require their exact expected schemas; exercise actual normal/O/OO duplicate-payload negatives.

new_reader_findings.actual_fragment: validate checks several integer counters, but does not validate the actual schema tag, finite nonnegative rr/build seconds, exact64GiB/two-thread/one-job policy, or resource_admission against the owned admission file.
new_reader_findings.concrete_trigger: A rehashed result can carry a negative seconds value or False max_parallel_jobs without a corresponding rejecting branch. This is a static path analysis; no accepted run is modified by this review.
new_reader_findings.impact: The mathematical proofs can stay valid while accepted resource/timing statements become inconsistent with the recorded execution.
new_reader_findings.repair: Pin exact schema and actual policy, compare strict integer admission fields with RESOURCE_ADMISSION.json, and check all reported durations are finite and nonnegative. Test the concrete float/bool/nonfinite mutations through actual CLIs.

new_reader_findings.actual_fragment: The dependency reader continues immediately for any path under a generic-library directory. It does not first reject an owned application module resolving under that prefix.
new_reader_findings.concrete_trigger: An extra mapped application-name object path inside a generic prefix can pass that individual line check. Required actual direct imports are also checked, so replacing the only real direct import is already rejected.
new_reader_findings.impact: The claimed blanket rejection of application objects masquerading as generic is not fully implemented by this route. This is narrower than a source-proof failure.
new_reader_findings.repair: Before generic-path admission, require every path whose suffix identifies a mapped application module to equal that exact accepted application-object path.

repair_policy: Only repair the new not-yet-accepted reader and preserve its pre-review bytes/hash. Do not change accepted723 readers, math sources, source captures or original outcomes. A later additive acceptance receipt must name the final repaired reader.
